data.description: Also put records back to their state at the restore point, in the touched collections. Default `false`.

items.description: A collection key or a field key: `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$`. Keys appear in URLs, filters and record bodies; `label` is the text people read.

collections.description: Limits putting records back to these touched collections. Default: all of them.

confirm.description: The `token` of the preview of exactly this request. Needed when the preview lists effects; a missing or outdated token is answered with `confirmation_required` and the current preview.

description: Restores a version. Send the `data` and `collections` of the preview together with its token as `confirm`.
